references.text: The same introductory formula 'the Lord spoke to Moses' is used consistently in the books of Moses to introduce God's commands and laws.
Identical wording where the Lord addresses Moses to give instructions about the tabernacle and worship.
The opening formula in Leviticus that establishes the pattern for divine revelation through Moses.
The same introductory formula that introduces the laws concerning the sin offering.
A parallel formulation where the Lord speaks to Moses, this time in the wilderness of Sinai.
Repetition of the fixed formula for divine speech to Moses followed by laws.
